# Setup

Load libraries:

```{r load-libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggbrace)
```

Create simplified records function:

```{r load-functions}
create_records_simple <- function(extinction_time, pse) {
  repeat {
    counts <- rpois(extinction_time, pse)
    if (any(counts[1:extinction_time] > 0)) break
  }

  records <- rep(seq_along(counts), counts)

  return(records)
}
```

Set seed for reproducibility:

```{r seed}
set.seed(123456)
```

# Figure

## A Extinct

```{r a-extinct}
A_Extinct_data_1 <- create_records_simple(49, 0.175)

A_Extinct_plot <- ggplot() +
  # Timeline
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 1,
    linewidth = 1,
    colour = "darkblue", alpha = 0.25
  ) +
  geom_linerange(
    aes(xmin = 0, xmax = 85, y = 1),
    linewidth = 1,
    colour = "darkblue"
  ) +
  annotate(
    geom = "text",
    x = 25, y = 0.95, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0,
    size = 3, colour = "darkblue",
    label = "← Time →",
  ) +
  # Extinction Time
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 50,
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  annotate(
    geom = "text",
    x = 50, y = 1.125, angle = 90, hjust = 0.5, vjust = -1,
    size = 3,
    label = "Extinction Time"
  ) +
  # Start Time
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = 0, y = 1.25, yend = 1.01),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm"), type = "closed"),
    linewidth = 1,
    colour = "grey50"
  ) +
  annotate(
    geom = "text",
    x = 0, y = 1.125, angle = 90, hjust = 0.5, vjust = -1,
    size = 3, colour = "grey50",
    label = "Start Time"
  ) +
  # Test Time
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = 85, y = 1.25, yend = 1.01),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm"), type = "closed"),
    linewidth = 1,
    colour = "grey50"
  ) +
  annotate(
    geom = "text",
    x = 85, y = 1.125, angle = 90, hjust = 0.5, vjust = -1,
    size = 3, colour = "grey50",
    label = "Test Time"
  ) +
  # Records
  geom_point(
    aes(x = A_Extinct_data_1, y = 1),
    size = 3,
    colour = "darkblue"
  ) +
  annotate(
    geom = "text",
    x = 25, y = 1.05, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1,
    size = 3, colour = "darkblue",
    label = "↓ Records ↓",
  ) +
  # Brackets
  stat_brace(
    data = data.frame(x = c(51, 84), y = c(0.9, 0.95)),
    aes(x, y),
    outside = FALSE,
    rotate = 180,
    linewidth = 1,
    colour = "grey50"
  ) +
  annotate(
    geom = "text",
    x = 67.5, y = 0.95, vjust = 0,
    size = 3, colour = "grey50",
    label = "Time Since Extinction"
  ) +
  # Subtitle
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 2, y = 1.2, hjust = 0, vjust = 0,
    label = "Extinct",
    fontface = "bold.italic"
  ) +
  lims(x = c(0, 100), y = c(0.85, 1.25)) +
  theme_void()
```

## A Extant

```{r a-extant}
A_Extant_data_1 <- create_records_simple(29, 0.3) # fudge so that we get a gap

A_Extant_plot <- ggplot() +
  # Timeline
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 1,
    linewidth = 1,
    colour = "darkblue", alpha = 0.25
  ) +
  geom_linerange(
    aes(xmin = 0, xmax = 50, y = 1),
    linewidth = 1,
    colour = "darkblue"
  ) +
  # Records
  geom_point(
    aes(x = A_Extant_data_1, y = 1),
    size = 3,
    colour = "darkblue"
  ) +
  # Start Time
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = 0, y = 1.25, yend = 1.01),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm"), type = "closed"),
    linewidth = 1,
    colour = "grey50"
  ) +
  annotate(
    geom = "text",
    x = 0, y = 1.125, angle = 90, hjust = 0.5, vjust = -1,
    size = 3, colour = "grey50",
    label = "Start Time"
  ) +
  # Test Time
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = 50, y = 1.25, yend = 1.01),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm"), type = "closed"),
    linewidth = 1,
    colour = "grey50"
  ) +
  annotate(
    geom = "text",
    x = 50, y = 1.125, angle = 90, hjust = 0.5, vjust = -1,
    size = 3, colour = "grey50",
    label = "Test Time"
  ) +
  # Brackets
  stat_brace(
    data = data.frame(x = c(max(A_Extant_data_1) + 1, 49), y = c(0.9, 0.95)),
    aes(x, y),
    outside = FALSE,
    rotate = 180,
    linewidth = 1,
    colour = "grey50"
  ) +
  annotate(
    geom = "text",
    x = (max(A_Extant_data_1) + 50) / 2, y = 0.95, vjust = 0,
    size = 3, colour = "grey50",
    label = "Time Since Last Sighting"
  ) +
  # Subtitle
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 2.5, y = 1.2, hjust = 0, vjust = 0,
    label = "Extant",
    fontface = "bold.italic"
  ) +
  lims(x = c(0, 50), y = c(0.85, 1.25)) +
  theme_void()
```

## A All

```{r a-all}
A_plot <- ggarrange(
  A_Extinct_plot, NULL, A_Extant_plot,
  ncol = 3, widths = c(1, 0.1, 1)
)

A_plot <- annotate_figure(
  A_plot,
  top = text_grob(
    "A) Scenario A: Gaps in the Sighting Record (Extinct & Extant)",
    x = 0, hjust = 0, size = 13.2
  )
)
```

## B Extinct

```{r b-extinct}
B_Extinct_data_1 <- create_records_simple(24, 0.175)
B_Extinct_data_2 <- create_records_simple(49, 0.175)

B_Extinct_plot <- ggplot() +
  # Timelines
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = c(1, 2),
    linewidth = 1,
    colour = "darkblue", alpha = 0.25
  ) +
  geom_linerange(
    aes(xmin = 0, xmax = 35, y = 1),
    linewidth = 1,
    colour = "darkblue"
  ) +
  annotate(
    geom = "text",
    x = 12.5, y = 1.2, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1,
    size = 3, colour = "darkblue",
    label = "Shorter Duration",
  ) +
  geom_linerange(
    aes(xmin = 0, xmax = 80, y = 2),
    linewidth = 1,
    colour = "darkblue"
  ) +
  annotate(
    geom = "text",
    x = 25, y = 2.2, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1,
    size = 3, colour = "darkblue",
    label = "Longer Duration",
  ) +
  # Extinction Time
  geom_linerange(
    aes(x = 50, ymin = 1.6, ymax = Inf),
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_linerange(
    aes(x = 25, ymin = -Inf, ymax = 1.4),
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  # Records
  geom_point(
    aes(x = B_Extinct_data_1, y = 1),
    size = 3,
    colour = "darkblue"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(x = B_Extinct_data_2, y = 2),
    size = 3,
    colour = "darkblue"
  ) +
  # Subtitle
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 2, y = 2.25, hjust = 0, vjust = 0,
    label = "Extinct",
    fontface = "bold.italic"
  ) +
  lims(x = c(0, 100), y = c(0.85, 2.45)) +
  theme_void()
```

## B Extant

```{r b-extant}
B_Extant_data_1 <- create_records_simple(44, 0.25)
B_Extant_data_2 <- B_Extant_data_1[B_Extant_data_1 <= 25]

B_Extant_plot <- ggplot() +
  # Timelines
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = c(1, 2),
    linewidth = 1,
    colour = "darkblue", alpha = 0.25
  ) +
  geom_linerange(
    aes(xmin = 0, xmax = 50, y = 1),
    linewidth = 1,
    colour = "darkblue"
  ) +
  annotate(
    geom = "text",
    x = 49, y = 1.2, hjust = 1, vjust = 1,
    size = 3, colour = "darkblue",
    label = "Truncated Later",
  ) +
  geom_linerange(
    aes(xmin = 0, xmax = 25, y = 2),
    linewidth = 1,
    colour = "darkblue"
  ) +
  annotate(
    geom = "text",
    x = 24, y = 2.2, hjust = 1, vjust = 1,
    size = 3, colour = "darkblue",
    label = "Truncated Earlier",
  ) +
  # Records
  geom_point(
    aes(x = B_Extant_data_1, y = 1),
    size = 3,
    colour = "darkblue"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(x = B_Extant_data_2, y = 2),
    size = 3,
    colour = "darkblue"
  ) +
  # Subtitle
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 2.5, y = 2.25, hjust = 0, vjust = 0,
    label = "Extant",
    fontface = "bold.italic"
  ) +
  lims(x = c(0, 50), y = c(0.85, 2.45)) +
  theme_void()
```
